data.name: 古咒迷途2渊海 lost curse 2 abyssal
data.detailed_description:
The gameplay and art assets in the current build do not represent the final game.

Lost Curse 2: Abyssal Sea is the official sequel to the acclaimed dark suspense JRPG Lost Curse. On this nightmare-devoured continent, trust is the deadliest poison—and the Holy Meteorite Iron in your hand is the only light that can pierce the darkness.

Intense, Strategic Combat

The game retains the beloved turn-based combat system from the original, requiring no fast reflexes but demanding patience and careful strategy. Every battle against nightmare clones that can mimic any human is filled with uncertainty and danger. While the game offers a fair challenge, with enough patience and smart combinations of gear and skills, you can overcome any enemy.

Gripping, Twist-Filled Story

The narrative is packed with non-stop surprises and shocking reversals. From the quiet White Mist Town to the desolate Holy Radiance City, anyone who offers you a helping hand could be a monster in human skin. You will navigate a web of lies and betrayal to uncover the earth-shattering secret behind the Pope's madness, and witness the promises guarded by two generations with their lives. The story draws inspiration from the core of shuangwen-style power fantasy, blended with unique dark suspense elements that will keep you hooked until the very end.

Gameplay

Holy Meteorite Iron & Equipment System

The Holy Meteorite Iron artifact is your only weapon against the nightmares. Defeat monsters to earn gear with fixed stats, or purchase equipment with randomized stats from shops. Invest in the shop to unlock even more powerful legendary gear that will drastically boost your attributes and amplify the power of your Holy Meteorite Iron skills. Consumables are also essential for your journey—available both from shops and monster drops to help you survive every encounter.

Skill Progression System

Skill growth is deeply tied to your character's development. As you level up, your base stats increase, and your skills become more powerful. Skills feature a wide damage range, and landing devastating critical hits depends on both luck and your equipment stats, as well as the awakening level of your Holy Meteorite Iron.

The Seven Seals Exploration

The game features a variety of meticulously designed maps, from cursed city districts to mysterious underground temple catacombs, from the Knights' training grounds to the long-forgotten library. Each seal location is a self-contained sandbox or labyrinth filled with hidden treasures and secrets left by the Pope. Thorough exploration of every corner is rewarded, making every adventure feel fresh and exciting.

Lost Curse 2: Abyssal Sea is more than just a traditional JRPG—it's a psychological game of trust and betrayal. Whether you enjoy shuangwen-style storytelling or classic turn-based combat, you will find something to love here.

This time, who will you dare to trust?

data.short_description: On a nightmare-devoured continent, players take a thrilling trip of trust and betrayal. Keeping the original classic JRPG turn-based combat, it blends fast-paced twist-packed shuangwen-style storytelling, delivering the ultimate thrill of uncovering truth in fatal fights against mimicking monsters.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphic board that works with OpenGL 4.4 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650 AMD Radeon™ RX570
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
